definitions.aligned_peak_edge_evidence: cosine and Kendall tau-b between d vectors at the shared, seed-independent residual-evidence peak after matching
definitions.co_membership: row-normalize H over hyperedges, form P=H H^T, exclude the diagonal, and compare upper triangles at each event point
definitions.hungarian_alignment: one event-wide maximum-cosine matching between flattened hyperedge incidence columns for each seed pair
definitions.neighbor_jaccard: Jaccard overlap of each variable's top-k neighbors induced by P
definitions.top1_partition_ari_nmi: ARI and arithmetic-mean NMI between per-variable top-1 hyperedge partitions at each event point; invariant to labels

label_use: frozen test labels locate the previously selected demonstration events only; no threshold, score, model, or metric is selected
revision_reason: Stage C v1 compared non-identifiable latent hyperedge IDs directly; v2 uses permutation-invariant induced relations and event-wide Hungarian alignment
